normalized.description: Capitalising on the existing 17.CPS.JP.022 - EU SatCom “Communication and Information System (CIS) Services for Headquarters and Deployed Forces”. More specifically, the framework contract will cover services such as theatre communication networks and IT networks for Headquarters. The objective is to provide commercially available Satellite Communications as well as related services and options for other communication services for CSDP operations/mission or contributing Members in Crisis Management activities including e.g. theatre local radio network, IT network backbone for HQs and crypto solutions for EUCI.
